findings.passage: With confidence, on behalf of the residents of House District 104 and the people of Texas, I express my strong and complete opposition to SB 1. I would have voted "no."
findings.note: Reason for vote printed in the House Journal after SB 1 (election integrity and security bill) passed 80-41 while she was absent. She describes the bill as making it harder to vote by mail and limiting other voting options.

findings.motion: SB 1 third reading, Record 61: listed as absent; filed a statement that she would have voted no
findings.note: SB 1 (election integrity and security) passed the House on third reading, 80 yeas to 41 nays. She was listed absent and her journal statement says she would have voted no.

findings.passage: “Unfortunately, this disregard for decorum and formal rules is all too common in the House Elections Committee,”
findings.note: Quoted by Dallas Voice from her letter to the U.S. Attorney General about how SB 7 (2021 voting bill) was moved through the House Elections Committee.

findings.motion: SJR 37 passed to third reading, Record 1897 (98 yeas, 18 nays)
findings.note: SJR 37 proposes a constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen. She is listed among the nays.
subjects: proof of citizenship to vote (constitutional amendment SJR 37)

findings.motion: SJR 37 adopted on third reading, Record 2196 (102 yeas, 14 nays): listed absent
findings.note: The House adopted SJR 37, the voter-citizenship constitutional amendment. She is listed as absent on the final vote.
subjects: proof of citizenship to vote (constitutional amendment SJR 37)
